instruction: Please enable Safe Browsing protection in Chrome.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling Safe Browsing security feature. Uses existing get_enable_safe_browsing getter which checks both standard and enhanced Safe Browsing settings, returns 'true' if either is enabled. Verified with exact_match metric.
metadata.verification: Uses existing Chrome security settings getter. Same complexity as original - requires navigating to Chrome settings to enable a security feature.

Getter returns 'true' if either standard or enhanced Safe Browsing is enabled, which matches Chrome's behavior (both are valid Safe Browsing protections)
Metric exact_match correctly receives rules={'expected': 'true'} (not wrapped in type/rules structure) and compares result string to expected string
Expected value 'true' is semantically correct for verifying Safe Browsing is enabled
Postconfig properly restarts Chrome to ensure settings are persisted and can be read from Preferences file
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the only requirement (Safe Browsing enabled) specified in the instruction
Data flow is correct: getter extracts boolean state from Chrome Preferences -> converts to 'true'/'false' string -> metric compares with expected 'true'
